nonBlockingObservations: The app emitted HTTP 401 and HTTP 500 resource errors in browser logs on several rendered QA routes; requested signup, login, mail rendering, verification, and reset behaviors still completed.
Welcome-email Explore destinations anchors went to /explore and settled at /destinations with a no-cities empty state.
Welcome-email Browse experts anchors went to /travel-experts and settled at /become-expert, where the current signup account identity was prefilled.
Verification/reset result copy was read from the native page before the query was scrubbed; screenshots were taken after scrubbing to avoid exposing signed URLs.

privacyHandling.note: One immediate loop-1 expert-form observation occurred before the email field was masked. That screenshot is excluded from the evidence references; all later expert-form screenshots were masked.
